fields.title: Underwater Adventure
fields.description: Dive into the clear lagoon for a day of colour and marine life. After a short boat ride you’ll snorkel in calm, shallow water, where green turtles and tropical fish are often seen. Then board a submarine to view the coral reef without getting wet. The day ends with a seafood lunch on a quiet islet. No experience is needed, and the guides help every step of the way.
fields.includes:
Boat transfer and snorkelling with turtles in the lagoon
Submarine safari to see the coral reef
Seafood lunch on a private islet

fields.title: Bois Chéri Tea Route & Tasting Tour
fields.description: Discover how Mauritian tea goes from leaf to cup on the green hills of the Bois Chéri plantation. Walk through the tea fields, visit the factory to see the drying and rolling process, and learn about the island’s tea heritage in the small museum. The tour ends with a tasting of several teas, including vanilla and fruit blends, with views over the plantation and the nearby lake. It’s a calm, scenic outing for tea lovers and curious travellers alike.
fields.includes:
Guided tour of the tea plantation and factory
Tasting of 3 teas with vanilla and fruit blends
Visit to the Bois Chéri museum and lake viewpoint

fields.title: Black River Gorges Hike & Waterfall Trek
fields.description: Explore Mauritius’s largest national park on a guided hike through lush native forest and rolling mountain scenery. Follow well-marked trails to the Alexandra Falls viewpoint and the dramatic Black River Gorges lookouts, with chances to spot rare birds along the way. Your local guide shares stories of the island’s plants, wildlife and history as you go. A packed lunch and hotel transfers are included, so you can simply enjoy the walk.
fields.includes:
Guided hike to Alexandra Falls and Black River viewpoints
Hotel pick-up and drop-off
Packed lunch, water and snacks

fields.title: Port Louis Heritage & Culture Walk
fields.description: Step into the story of Mauritius with a guided walk through the capital’s most meaningful places, led by a local cultural historian. Wander the lively Central Market, stroll along the Caudan Waterfront, and visit the Blue Penny Museum and the UNESCO-listed Aapravasi Ghat. Along the way you’ll taste local street food and hear how Indian, African, European and Chinese communities shaped the island’s culture. It’s an easy walk full of history and flavour.
fields.includes:
Guided walk through the Central Market and Caudan Waterfront
Entry to the Blue Penny Museum and Aapravasi Ghat
Local street food tasting along the way

fields.title: Blue Bay Catamaran & Snorkelling Cruise
fields.description: Sail across the turquoise waters of the south-east on a relaxed catamaran cruise. Stop in Blue Bay Marine Park to snorkel over healthy coral gardens and watch colourful fish all around you. Your guide explains how the reef works and how to enjoy it without harming it. Fresh fruit and cold drinks are served on board as you sail back.
fields.includes:
Catamaran sail along the south-east coast
Snorkelling stop in Blue Bay Marine Park
Fresh fruit and drinks on board

fields.title: Mahebourg & Vieux Grand Port Heritage Tour
fields.description: Travel to the south-east, where Mauritius’s colonial story began. Visit the National History Museum in Mahebourg and walk through the old Vieux Grand Port site, where Dutch, French and British history meet. Your guide connects each place to the stories of the people who lived there. The day ends with a traditional Mauritian lunch at a local restaurant.
fields.includes:
Visit to the National History Museum in Mahebourg
Guided tour of the Vieux Grand Port heritage site
Traditional Mauritian lunch

fields.title: Spice Garden & Creole Cooking Experience
fields.description:
Wander through a garden of vanilla, cinnamon, turmeric and chilli, and learn how each spice is grown and used. Then join a hands-on cooking session and prepare classic Creole dishes with fresh local ingredients. You sit down together to enjoy the meal you made. Everyone leaves with written recipes to try again at home.
Picture: a spice garden or a table of Creole dishes
fields.includes:
Walk through a working spice garden
Hands-on Creole cooking session
Shared lunch with recipes to take home

fields.title: Le Morne Sunrise Hike
fields.description: Start early and climb Le Morne Brabant as the sun comes up over the lagoon. The trail is steep in places, so your guide sets a steady pace and gives a safety briefing before you start. At the top you get wide views over the south-west coast and the famous underwater waterfall effect. A simple breakfast and water are waiting when you come down.
fields.includes:
Early-morning guided hike with a safety briefing
Panoramic views over the lagoon at sunrise
Breakfast and water after the hike
